                  - generic [ref=e2864]: As a condition and obligation for the consideration of your application with WoodmenLife, you and WoodmenLife (collectively, the “Parties”) agree to resolve any and all claims, demands, causes of action, charges and disputes of any nature whatsoever, arising out of or relating to your application or candidacy for employment (each a “Dispute”), exclusively by final and binding arbitration before a neutral arbitrator and in accordance with WoodmenLife’s normal and customary dispute resolution procedures. By way of example only, such Disputes include but are not limited to, claims relating to the purported validity, interpretation, enforceability or breach of any policy of WoodmenLife or any purported employment agreement and/or any other claim or controversy arising out of the application or candidacy for employment, claims under federal, state and local statutory or common law, such as the Age Discrimination in Employment Act, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, as amended, including the amendments of the Civil Rights Act of 1991, the Americans with Disabilities Act, the law of contract and the law of tort. Except as otherwise set forth herein, this Agreement shall apply to any and all Disputes whether asserted against WoodmenLife and/or against any employee, officer, alleged agent, director, affiliate or subsidiary of WoodmenLife, unless such Dispute is governed by WoodmenLife’s Constitution and Laws, which provisions shall take precedence. A Dispute does not include a dispute (i) involving a nonconsensual sexual act or sexual contact as such terms are defined in 18 U.S.C. § 2246 or similar applicable Tribal or State law, or (ii) relating to conduct that is alleged to constitute sexual harassment under applicable Federal, Tribal, or State law (collectively, “Sexual Misconduct Dispute”); provided, however, that nothing herein shall be construed so as to prohibit you from resolving a Sexual Misconduct Dispute in accordance with the WoodmenLife’s dispute resolution procedures should you so elect. The Dispute shall be settled by arbitration administered by and in accordance with the applicable rules of the American Arbitration Association or other comparable organization mutually agreeable to the Parties. In any case, the arbitration procedures shall allow for each Party to be represented by legal counsel of their choosing, to have reasonable notice of the date and time of arbitration and the issues to be arbitrated, and to have reasonable access to and discovery of relevant information. The Parties’ Agreement to arbitrate shall be governed by the Federal Arbitration Act, found at 9 U.S.C. §§1-16, as amended, and the place of arbitration shall be Douglas County, Nebraska, unless otherwise mutually agreed by the Parties. Each Party shall bear its own expenses, including attorney’s fees and costs, and the costs of arbitration shall be borne one half by each Party, unless the Parties agree otherwise or unless otherwise ordered by the arbitrator consistent with applicable law. The Parties agree the arbitrator shall have no power to adjudicate, hear, decide, or award remedies for injuries that you or WoodmenLife have not personally/directly experienced (“Non-individual” claims). The arbitrator shall have no authority or power to make class, collective, or Non-individual representative decisions, allow class, collective, or Non-individual representative discovery, or award class, collective or Non-individual representative remedies. The Parties agree that no class, collective, or representative action may be brought, and no Non-individual claims or claims by multiple parties may be consolidated or joined in arbitration proceedings contemplated by this Agreement unless all Parties agree in writing. The Parties knowingly waive, to the maximum extent permitted by law, any right to initiate, maintain, or participate in a class, collective, or representative action to enforce any rights or resolve any Dispute, whether in arbitration or in court, and whether seeking legal or equitable relief. Neither party shall be entitled to (and will decline to accept) any recovery from such an action. The Parties acknowledge and agree to the waiver of all available federal, state, and local judicial procedures and remedies (including any right to a trial by jury) in favor of arbitration, except as otherwise set forth herein. This Agreement does not apply to actions by WoodmenLife or you for injunctive relief. The acts of seeking and obtaining injunctive relief shall not constitute a waiver of WoodmenLife’s or your right to require arbitration as to any other Disputes governed by this Agreement. Should a court or arbitrator conclude for any reason that the Federal Arbitration Act does not apply to a Dispute governed by this Agreement to arbitrate, the Parties hereby express the specific intent to require and follow the WoodmenLife arbitration and dispute resolution procedures to the maximum extent permitted under applicable law. Nothing in this Agreement prevents you from discussing or disclosing information about possible violation of law or regulations, nor is it intended to limit in any way your right or ability to cooperate, communicate or file a charge or claim with any federal, state, or local agency, including, but not limited to the National Labor Relations Board, the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, any other Fair Employment Practices Agency, or any comparable agency. These agencies have the authority to carry out their own statutory duties by investigating charges or claims, issuing determinations, filing lawsuits in their own name, or taking other action authorized by statute. Any provision in this Agreement which is prohibited or unenforceable in any jurisdiction shall, as to such jurisdiction, be ineffective to the extent of such prohibition or unenforceability without invalidating the remaining provisions or affecting the validity or enforceability of such provision in any other jurisdiction. If you agree to the terms of this Agreement as a condition for consideration of your employment, please check the box below and select the “Next” button. By checking the box below and selecting “Next”, you understand this represents your electronic signature and your commitment to this Agreement. You acknowledge that you have carefully read this Agreement, that you understand its terms, and that you have entered into the Agreement voluntarily and not in reliance on any promises or representations by WoodmenLife other than those contained in the Agreement itself. By continuing this application process with WoodmenLife, you agree to accept and be by bound by the terms of the Agreement.
